text: In your hand, your first Signal Shard hums, warm and blue.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: You've got grit, kid. Here's your first Signal Shard. And watch those Helix suits poking around my yard.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Hold on. That badge on your jacket... R.B. No. 1. You're Wren's grandkid! Then I've got something of hers for you.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: Helix is siphoning my spore pools! Run them off, then show me what you've learned.

speaker: Narrator
text: Behind a giant mushroom, a Helix grunt kneels beside a little cage.

speaker: Narrator
text: He flips the latch. A tiny glowing sporeling hops out and bounces away into the mist.

text: He looks up and sees you watching... then puts a finger to his lips.

speaker: Strand
text: ...You didn't see that, and I didn't see you. Name's Strand.

text: Zib remembers.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib floats over the humming Shard, and its big eye begins to glow.

text: It paints a picture in the air: a deep red world, launching glowing seeds into space.

speaker: Narrator
text: You whisper: Was that... your home? Zib's lights go very quiet.

speaker: Narrator
text: Escape through the ice.

speaker: Narrator
text: Halfway to Sporeholm, an orange tractor beam locks onto Nana Wren's little ship.

speaker: Narrator
text: You dive between tumbling chunks of ice, and one snaps the beam clean in half!

speaker: Narrator

text: ...Back on Glyphos, Zib blinks.

text: For a split second, its big eye reflects something enormous: a giant dark eye, opening.

speaker: Narrator
text: The murals show it plainly: a dying world called Ystra, a void that ate the stars, and a great tree-mother sending her children away in seedpods. The Alienmon are refugees.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Teo Reyes? Sure, I knew him. Six years ago he stood at the crater's edge, smiling, saying he could hear a song.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Then he walked into the light and didn't come back.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Sixty years in the mines. Show me your fire.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Hmph. The fire in you burns true.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Find Teo's girl. She deserves to know.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Tell Sola her pa was the bravest fool I ever met. Here, your fifth Shard.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: The ice holds something you need to see. Fossils... with bite marks the size of moons.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the snow, a prickly little Iceburr is stuck, one leg frozen into the ice.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kit kneels down, pulls a tiny heater coil off his tool belt, and gently melts it free.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Iceburr shakes itself off... and hops onto Kit's shoulder. Kit: Ow. Spiky. Hi, friend.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Let's see if you can keep your cool.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: You thawed my best defense. Impressive.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Whatever made those bite marks is still out there.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: The Devourer isn't a legend. But look closer: Ystran creatures, Ystran trees... and no fossil of the Seedmother. Not one bone.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Because there was nothing left to bite. She'd already gone.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Take the sixth Shard. We'll need every tower standing.

speaker: Grub
text: Psst. I used to work for Helix. Their Forge Fortress has a shuttle keycard in the control room. Get it and you can reach Helix Station.

speaker: Narrator
text: You swipe a Helix Keycard from the control terminal. The fortress shuttle pad lights up.

speaker: Narrator
text: A cold white sign hangs over the cage rows: PROJECT UNITY. ONE OF EVERY SPECIES.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every cage has a label, a number and a species name, like a museum.

speaker: Admin Bronn
text: Thorne's lost his mind. That Rift will swallow us all. Beat me and I'll open the way to Vex.

speaker: Narrator
text: After the battle you play Sola the recording from the Deep Mines. "If you find this, Sola, I'm not lost."

text: Before she can answer, the deck's big screen flickers on by itself. Two files play.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: Reyes was an acceptable loss. The data he left behind was worth it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sola goes completely still.

speaker: Narrator
text: The second file: a reactor alarm, a woman's voice, then silence. Elena Thorne, lost in a Helix accident.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: If the Rift can power anything, it can power a way back to her.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: Project Unity is nearly complete. One of every species. Carry them all through the Rift and the Seedmother regrows life the way I choose.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: She will give me Elena back.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: ...An acceptable loss. That's what he called my dad.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: They lied to me. Thorne never wanted to find my dad. He wants to OPEN the thing that took him.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sola rips the Helix patch off her sleeve and throws it on the floor.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: He's not data. He's my dad.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: I'm with you. Let's finish this, together.

speaker: Narrator
text: Admin Vex escapes in a pod, shrieking about the Director.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: We did it. Together.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: We already saw you climb these stairs. We also saw the sky tear open.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the third wind shrine, the wind falls silent. Carved across the whole shrine wall is one great picture.

speaker: Liss
text: You have been told she stayed behind on Ystra. She didn't. She couldn't.

speaker: Liss
text: As the hungry one ate our sky, the Seedmother broke her whole self apart into the seedpods. Every Alienmon carries a piece of her. Zib. Your partner. All of them.

speaker: Liss
text: On Ystra only the Heartroot is left, one last root in the crater where her tree stood. And it is fading.

speaker: Liss
text: This is the rest of the line Teo copied: "She is scattered so she may live. Whoever reunites all her children will let the Seedmother grow again, and her world with her."

speaker: Liss
text: Reunite, Linker. Not cage. Every one of them stays itself.

speaker: Narrator
text: Echo and Iris: We already saw this battle. Shall we see how it ends?

speaker: Narrator
text: Echo and Iris: The vision changed. Because of you.

speaker: Narrator
text: Echo and Iris: The Rift. The shadow. A girl and her father. We saw it all.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: The vision is clear now. The Rift opens at the Starfall crater. Take the seventh Shard.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: I built the Rift engine for Thorne. I scratched the logo off my coat the day I understood what it would wake.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: The Devourer follows the light. Prove you can stand in the dark.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: You're ready. Take the last shard.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: With 8 shards, the Rift will let you land. Stop Thorne.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: Eight Shards. The towers will sing. Go to the crater before Thorne does.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: Linker! Get to Port Saltreach. I've found where Helix is hiding my tower core.

speaker: Narrator
text: Captain Marsh slots the core back into the Harbor Tower. For a second, nothing.

speaker: Narrator
text: Then the whole tower hums, and a beam of light shoots up into the night. Every boat in the harbor sounds its horn.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: Now we're even.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: The seal's got one more tower singing. Go get that crater, kid.

speaker: Narrator
text: The valley is full of cracked, glowing seedpod shells. Zib zips straight past all of them...

speaker: Narrator
text: ...and stops at one small shell, half-buried in the rock.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib lands inside it and sits very still for a long, quiet minute. Its lights go soft and pink.

speaker: Narrator
text: This was Zib's pod. The last one Liss launched.

speaker: Strand
text: Linker! Meet me in Dustmere's plaza. I'm done with Helix.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: Halt. This crater has been under military guard for twenty years.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: I don't care how many Shards you carry. No children go past this camp.

speaker: Tamsin
text: General! They're with me.

speaker: Tamsin
text: I've mapped every inch of this crater, and I'll be at their side the whole way down. You have my word.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: ...Fine. But if anything happens, Tamsin, it's on you.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Told you I'd turn up. Come on. Stay close.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: Pell! The little saucer. Net it. NOW.

speaker: Narrator
text: Pell raises the net gun. His hands are shaking.

speaker: Pell
text: Helix Directive... Field Division... ...No.

speaker: Narrator
text: Pell throws the net gun over the rim. It tumbles down into the crater's light.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: You'll regret that.

speaker: Narrator
text: Your eight Shards rise and resonate. A great signal-winged bird answers the call: Novaryx!

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: The Rift is power, child. Power the universe wasted on refugees.

speaker: Narrator
text: A Helix gravity trap snaps on. Everyone is pinned flat to the glowing rock.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Iceburr, freeze the coils! Now!

speaker: Narrator
text: Iceburr frosts the trap's coils until they crack. The pull lets go.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Got it! Keep moving, everybody.

beat: scene: The Rift closes: the Signal song
speaker: Narrator
text: Thorne stares through the Rift, looking for the power he was promised. He sees Ystra: grey, barren, empty. No Seedmother to command. Nothing to answer him.

beat: scene: The Rift closes: the Signal song
speaker: Narrator
text: Only Oblivane, starving and enormous. The power he wanted doesn't exist. He drops to his knees.

beat: scene: The Rift closes: the Signal song
speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: Reroute the engine to the seal. I'll hold it. Go!

beat: scene: The Rift closes: the Signal song
speaker: Narrator
text: Zib pours its light into the Shards. One by one, its lights start to go out.

beat: scene: The Rift closes: the Signal song
speaker: Narrator
text: You, Sola, Novaryx and Zib start to sing the Signal. It's the Spore Choir's song from Sporeholm. Hmm-mm-mmm.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Shards blaze and the Rift folds shut. From the last of its light steps Teo Reyes, an adult Lumivex at his side. Sola runs to him.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: Sola? ...You're so tall.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: The seal can only be healed from Ystra's side. And there's something you need to know.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: The Heartroot, the last piece of her on Ystra, is dying. If it dies, the legend can't come true.

speaker: Mom
text: You're home! Come on, the whole town is at the Starfall Festival tonight.

beat: picture: The Crater Four (plazmo starter only)
speaker: Narrator
text: The Crater Four.

beat: picture: The Crater Four (plazmo starter only)
speaker: Narrator
text: Before the trial, Dr. Vashti asks you and Kit up to her lab on Neonis.

beat: picture: The Crater Four (plazmo starter only)
speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: The four kids in the crater were me, Kael, Orra... and Teo Reyes.

beat: picture: The Crater Four (plazmo starter only)
speaker: Narrator
text: Zib floats up and bumps its saucer gently against her cheek.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the Linker League courtroom, Strand testifies with shaking hands.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Vashti testifies too, and confesses her own twenty years of silence, in public, for everyone to hear.

speaker: Narrator
text: Director Thorne pleads guilty to everything. He looks at no one.

speaker: Narrator
text: A week later, a letter arrives from his cell. Folded inside is a Codex page he copied twenty years ago.

speaker: Narrator
text: Codex page: The door that is a road opens only for a scout and a listener, together.

speaker: Narrator
text: Codex page: But she cannot grow while the hungry one still hungers. Heal it first. Then call her children home.

speaker: Narrator
text: A message arrives from Apex Array, from Orra Venn, the Prime Linker and the last of the Crater Four.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: Come to the Summit.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Vashti reads it twice. Vashti: Orra and I haven't spoken in fifteen years.

speaker: Mom
text: The Summit, huh? Go on. Make your Nana proud.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: The Quorum waits in four halls. Beat them all, then come find me under the great telescope.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: Go on, then. The Prime Linker is waiting.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: My first Linker still works. Let's see if yours can outshine it.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: The Kessler system has a new Prime Linker. Carry the secret differently. Carry it in the open.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib's lights blink in a rhythm you've never seen. It's pointing up, at the Great Telescope.

speaker: Narrator
text: You and Zib hum the Spore Choir's song. Hmm-mm-mmm.

speaker: Narrator
text: The sky above the telescope folds open into a spinning road of light.

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: Go. I'll hold the road open from this side. However long it takes.

speaker: Narrator
text: A last message from Thorne arrives on her screen: "Bring her home, all of her."

speaker: Narrator
text: You step out of the Vortex under a huge, tired red sun. Ystra is barren: grey crystal, nothing growing. The crystal forest from your dream is a dead, chiming ruin.

speaker: Liss
text: Look. Far off, at the bottom of that empty crater. That single faint glow is the Heartroot, the last piece of her on Ystra.

speaker: Liss
text: The legend says whoever reunites all her children lets her grow again. But nothing can grow while Oblivane still hungers.

speaker: Narrator
text: A hooded figure has followed you through the Vortex. It's Saga, the silent Quorum master.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga lowers the hood. Underneath is a face like clear crystal, flickering at the edges.

speaker: Saga
text: I am a Ystran echo. I came in the Mother Pod and lived twenty years in a borrowed human shape, guarding the Vortex secret.

speaker: Saga
text: The one who launched your little scout... Liss... is my sister.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib flashes every color at once. So that was the word Saga whispered at the Summit.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tamsin finds a ruined room covered in star charts: the Ystran explorers' map room.

speaker: Narrator
text: On the wall is a symbol shaped exactly like the question mark on her vest.

speaker: Saga
text: That word means "the place we haven't found yet."

speaker: Narrator
text: Tamsin sits down on the floor and laughs until she cries.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Forty years. Forty years I've been looking for this. I think I'll stay a while.

speaker: Narrator
text: The forest is gray and silent here. Small shadow creatures creep out of the dead trees and swarm toward you.

speaker: Narrator
text: Your team braces for a fight... then you see it. They aren't attacking.

speaker: Narrator
text: They're reaching for your light. They're begging.

speaker: Narrator
text: The ground simply stops. Beyond it is a darkness so complete it has no shape.

speaker: Narrator
text: Something enormous is breathing inside it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Oblivane is calm at last, small and silver. Light returns to Ystra's sky... but the land stays bare. The job isn't finished.

speaker: Liss
text: Now. The Heartroot's crater. Before its light goes out.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kit's Shard relay and Static's frequency send the call home to Kessler.

speaker: Narrator
text: Above the crater, the Warp Gate wakes for the first time and opens a road between the worlds.

speaker: Narrator
text: And they come through it: Hank, Captain Marsh, DJ Static, Ingrid, Old Basalt, Echo and Iris, Kade, every trainer you ever battled, even Pell.

speaker: Narrator
text: Wild Alienmon of every kind pour through the Gate behind them.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every Alienmon sings one note of her song. Nobody gives up their body or their life, only a note. Every one of them stays itself.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Heartroot drinks the song. Green floods out across Ystra.

speaker: Narrator
text: A world-tree of crystal and leaves rises out of the crater: the Seedmother, growing again.

speaker: Narrator
text: She holds Oblivane, small and silver now, like a moon in her branches.

speaker: The Seedmother
text: Thank you, my children. Every one of you still yourselves.

speaker: The Seedmother
text: Take this seed. The Gate will stay open, a road between your two homes.

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: The Warp Gate is still open, on every scope in the system! Go and see it from our side.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Warp Gate's runes blaze cyan and pink. A road between two worlds, open at last.
